name: LookaheadGroupFails
grammar: grammar LookaheadGroupFails { @package: org.example.ruletrivia @whitespace: none token AH = LOOKAHEAD('xyz')  @root @mapping(Root) R0 ::= 'a' AH ( 'x' 'q' ) ; }

grammar: grammar LookaheadChoiceFails { @package: org.example.ruletrivia @whitespace: none token AH = LOOKAHEAD('xyz')  @root @mapping(Root) R0 ::= 'a' AH ( 'x' 'q' | 'x' 'r' ) ; }

grammar: grammar LookaheadBoundedGroupRepeatFails { @package: org.example.ruletrivia @whitespace: none token AH = LOOKAHEAD('xyz')  @root @mapping(Root) R0 ::= 'a' AH ( 'x' 'y' ){2} ; }

grammar: grammar LookaheadNegativeTokenFails { @package: org.example.ruletrivia @whitespace: none token AH = LOOKAHEAD('xyz') token NEXT = NEGATIVE_LOOKAHEAD('yz') @root @mapping(Root) R0 ::= 'a' AH ( 'x' NEXT ) ; }

grammar: grammar LookaheadGroupReadsLookahead { @package: org.example.ruletrivia @whitespace: none token AH = LOOKAHEAD('xyz') token NEXT = LOOKAHEAD('yz') @root @mapping(Root) R0 ::= 'a' AH ( 'x' NEXT 'y' 'z' ) ; }

grammar: grammar LookaheadGroupFailureMemo { @package: org.example.ruletrivia @whitespace: none token AH = LOOKAHEAD('xyz')  @root @mapping(Root) R0 ::= 'a' AH R1 'w' | 'a' AH R1 'v' ;  R1 ::= ( 'x' 'q' ) ; }

name: LookaheadGroupSuccessMemo
grammar: grammar LookaheadGroupSuccessMemo { @package: org.example.ruletrivia @whitespace: none token AH = LOOKAHEAD('xyz')  @root @mapping(Root) R0 ::= 'a' AH R1 'w' | 'a' AH R1 'v' ;  R1 ::= ( 'x' 'q' | 'x' ) ; }
